lineages.name: desk: Desk Terminal, Patched (main camp)
lineages.idea: a docked terminal column: one real cased terminal beside the family's desk, Home's question typed at the foot of its glass

lineages.name: quote: Quote Board, Posted (main camp)
lineages.idea: a count board: each section led by one big quote or figure, read at a glance

lineages.name: dessau: Dessau, Wired Through (main camp)
lineages.idea: Bauhaus display type: a modernist poster's hierarchy and geometry around the green screens

lineages.name: trued: Trued, Headlamp (tour camp)
lineages.idea: the track series: the family's week as a signal box's lit track diagram; the greeting its own lit board with the ways to start on a steel branch, Next up as the line's first stop

lineages.name: manual: Lit Manual, Slotted (tour camp)
lineages.idea: the family's operator manual: every list in time hangs from a rail with one lit NOW, every section led by a figure drawn from its own data

lineages.name: departures: Departures, Signalled (tour camp)
lineages.idea: a station at night: Vera's line down the left with the box as its first stop, a dot-matrix departures board beside it

lineages.name: settled: Switchboard, Quoted (tour camp)
lineages.idea: the videotex sommaire settled: Home as a two-tier map of the service, every inner page on one rack with its own sized tube

lineages.name: plate: Plate, Engraved (main camp)
lineages.idea: a long-persistence instrument: a cut matte plate over one lit screen

lineages.name: listing: Listing, Lit Through (main camp)
lineages.idea: a programme listing: the family's evening set as a TV listings page, bands with a head column

lineages.name: folio: Folio, Railed Contents (main camp)
lineages.idea: a videotex service as a folio: numbered pages of one service, read like a teletext magazine

lineages.name: sill: Sill Line, Squared (tour camp)
lineages.idea: the track series' bolder Home: the question as the board's headline, the tube's lit wire dropping onto the Coming up rail, To do's stops the ticks you press

lineages.name: pocket: Pocket Diary, Lit (tour camp)
lineages.idea: the family's pocket diary: one steel line of time from Now to Later, every date set as a diary sets a day

lineages.name: waypoint: Waypoint, Ruled (tour camp)
lineages.idea: a 1969 flight console: a readout strip, the weeks as a flight plan whose waypoint rings carry the day numerals that lead the rows
